# Holloway

> Holloway is a digital publishing platform empowering authors to publish, monetize, and build audiences through comprehensive guides and direct reader connections.

Holloway specializes in high-quality digital books and guides covering professional topics like remote work, engineering, venture capital, and recruiting. The platform combines self-publishing tools with curated editorial standards to help authors reach engaged audiences.

## Key Topics

- Self-publishing
- Digital publishing
- Author platform
- Book publishing
- Remote work
- Distributed teams
- Management practices
- Direct reader connection
- Indie publishing
- Manuscript submission
- Employee handbook
- Work-from-home
- Team building
- Comprehensive reference
- Hybrid work

## Publishing & Author Platform

- [Publish Your Book on Holloway](https://www.holloway.com/publish-on-holloway): Platform for authors to publish, monetize, and grow audience on Holloway

## Guides & Resources

- [The Holloway Guide to Remote Work](https://www.holloway.com/g/remote-work/about): Comprehensive guide to building and managing distributed teams effectively
- [Holloway Editorial Principles](https://www.holloway.com/g/editorial-principles): Editorial standards and content guidelines for Holloway publications

## Community & News

- [Holloway Blog](https://www.holloway.com/s/holloway-blog): Blog index covering career, engineering, VC, and recruiting topics
